additional_info.subject: RE: ID0391872-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R6 170002130] DC 2 Unavailable CRM:00641000789
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
As discussed, the AWS CloudWatch logs indicate repeated issues with the DC_Contactor_DC2 for QA13-14. To address this effectively, we recommend planning a site intervention.
Kindly refer the below logs and its explanation.
CMD: 0, FBK: 0, WLE: 1, WDA: 1, WLD: 1, WIR: 0, WCD: 0
WDA: 1-: WDA
: true = welded detection algorithm has all necessary interlocks for detection ok and therefore is active.
WLD: 1,
-: WLD: true = welded has been detected.
Below is a structured approach for troubleshooting to assist during the visit:
Troubleshooting Steps:
Check the Coils:
Supply 24V separately to the coils (QA13-14).
Observe if they pick up properly.
Evaluate Contactor Condition:
If the coils (QA13-14) are not picking up properly when voltage is supplied, the contactors might be faulty.
Replace or repair the contactors as needed.
Check Auxiliary Contactors:
If the coils pick up properly, the next step is to inspect the auxiliary contactors.
Ensure these are functioning correctly, as they control the main DC output for charging.
Verify Feedback to PLC:
Check the feedback mechanism that provides the status to the PLC.
Ensure that the feedback signals are accurate and correctly interpreted by the PLC.
Kindly refer to the attached schematics for further clarity during troubleshooting.
And keep in mind that please carry the spare contactor if replacement is needed.
Spare part QA13-14 -: 8EM5903-0AA00-7AA8
Please let us know if additional support or clarifications are required from our side. Looking forward to your confirmation regarding the site visit.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
